content_of_post_to_comment: i crave routine but can never stick with it, and i have fallen into the mindset im not smart enough to do anything. i am now medicated and it does wonders but its taking a lot to get myself right. i have a vague plan for college/switching to a job in the field im interested in for experience, and im more hopeful than ever, but its still so hard. has anyone else started "late"? still dont have my GED, only have my drivers permit, stuck in the USA while the economy and society crumbles. my upward change is happening but its slow, i feel like im losing a race.
comment: Getting your GED and building a new direction while also adjusting to medication is a lot of moving pieces at once. I think the “late” feeling can be misleading because a lot of people spend years stuck before they even get to the point of making a plan. Progress that feels slow is still progress, especially when you’re rebuilding your foundation.
